title: Lexogen QuantSeq-Pool Sample-Barcoded 3-Prime mRNA-Seq Library Prep Kit for Illumina
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the OT app to pre‑cool the temperature module to 4 °C before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes on deck
steps.instruction: Ensure all required reagents are loaded on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will alert the user if any are missing.

steps.title: Add RNA to RT primer
steps.instruction: Manually add 10‑120 ng total RNA in 7 µL to the dried‑in sample‑barcode RT primer in each of the 8‑96 wells of the index plate (slot 8), mix to dissolve the primer, incubate 3 min at 85 °C, cool to 25 °C, spin briefly, and return the plate to slot 8.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 7 µL of RNA (10‑120 ng) into each well containing dried RT primer.
Place the plate back in slot 8.

steps.title: Assemble and add RT mastermix
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel P20 and P300 pipettes, prepare the reverse‑transcription mastermix and add 3 µL of it to each well that now contains RNA and primer.

steps.title: Incubate RT reactions
steps.instruction: Incubate the reverse‑transcription reactions off‑deck for 15 minutes at 42 °C.

steps.title: Pool reactions and bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Pool the RT reactions into one well (or two wells if >56 samples) of the magnetic module plate, then perform a bead cleanup using user‑defined bead‑drying time and magnet‑engage time.

substeps.instruction: If the number of samples exceeds 56, split the pool into two wells; otherwise use a single well.
Add magnetic beads according to the kit instructions.
Engage the magnet for the user‑specified time.
Wash and dry beads for the user‑specified drying time.

steps.title: Combine eluates and treat
steps.instruction: Combine all eluates into a single pool, treat with RNA removal solution, perform second‑strand synthesis, and conduct a second bead cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Add RNA removal solution to the combined eluate.
Incubate as recommended for RNA removal.
Add second‑strand synthesis reagents and incubate per kit instructions.
Perform a second magnetic‑bead cleanup (using user‑defined bead‑drying and magnet times).

steps.title: Assemble and add PCR mastermix
steps.instruction: Using the single‑channel P20 pipette, assemble the PCR mastermix and add it to the treated library pool.

steps.title: PCR amplification and final cleanup
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for off‑deck PCR library amplification, then return to perform a final bead cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Run PCR amplification on a thermal cycler according to the kit’s cycling conditions.
After PCR, perform a magnetic‑bead cleanup (user‑defined bead‑drying and magnet times).
